aisha_ng: Hey team — Bluefield asked if we can run two 30-min evening hands-on clinics next week for their APAC infra/eng cohort. Goal: quick Dedicated migration checklist + 1:1 prompt tuning walkthrough. Their preferred windows: 23:00–01:30 UTC or 12:30–15:00 UTC. Can we cover both? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
onboard-bot: Poll opened — please mark availability: https://doodle.example/bluefield-microclinic (auto-collects timezone). Slots added: Tue 23:30 UTC, Wed 00:30 UTC, Thu 12:30 UTC, Fri 13:00 UTC.
marco_t: I can host Tue 23:30 UTC (that’s Wed 08:30 JST for me). I’ll prep a tiny repo + runbook. Anything must-have in the runbook? :white_check_mark:
priya_s: Thanks Marco — please add a 5-min renewal-risk checklist at the end (billing sync, recent perf regressions, action owner). Bluefield flagged a renewal signal in Q4; quick ops triage would be helpful. Also include notes on private deployment networking gotchas.
luca_m: Suggest keeping each session to 30 min: 15m demo (migration + quick perf test) / 10m hands-on pair (they run a short prompt) / 5m wrap + renewal check. Example agenda below:
```
- 00:00–00:03: quick intro & goals
- 00:03–00:18: migration checklist + demo (config, routing, creds)
- 00:18–00:28: hands-on: run two test prompts, inspect latency/cost
- 00:28–00:30: wrap, renewal-risk sniff (billing/perf/coverage)
```
aisha_ng: perfect. @onboard-bot can you create calendar invites once we have the poll winner and attach the repo link? Also please surface a short feedback form (1–2 Qs) after each clinic.
onboard-bot: Sure — will create invites and post invites + a short form link when poll closes. Example form template: https://forms.gle/example (will auto-tag customer & session).
marco_t: I’ll take the Tue 23:30 slot and will add a small `prompts.md` with 3 test prompts. Quick ask — can somebody paste the sample prompts we usually use for ded migrations?
aisha_ng: Copying a quick set below — keep them tiny:
- "Migrate model to dedicated pool and summarize expected latency improvements."
- "Given sample input X, what caching policy would you recommend to reduce token counts?"
- "Run a cost estimate for 100k tokens/month with quantized 8-bit model variant."

aisha_ng: Ok team — once poll locks I’ll post final times + calendar invites. Marco, please drop the repo link in this thread when ready and Priya, can you draft the 3-line renewal checklist we’ll read out? :pray: Thanks!
